description: New Residence in Puntas NeighborhoodNOT a Container Home; High Ceilings and Open Concept DistributionBohemian Decoration Surrounded by Nature Modern Eco-Conscious DesignParking Inside the PropertySaltwater PoolKing Bed TV/Surround SystemFully Equipped Kitchen, Expresso Coffee Machine Full Capacity Backup Generator/Water CisternsAlmost one Acre to walk around; no direct neighbors3 Minute Drive to the BeachKids Friendly3 Decks; Perfect for LeisureBBQ Area with Pool Side ViewThe spaceDiscover Cabaña Serena, a serene 2-bedroom retreat with an optional addition of Estudio Sereno (a separate studio/bedroom #3 available for an extra fee). Nestled in Rincón, Puerto Rico’s vibrant boho-surf town, this lush oasis offers peace, privacy, and proximity—just a 3-minute drive to top beaches and world-renowned surf breaks.The main cabin’s bohemian-inspired interior features a fully equipped kitchen, a cozy living area with a TV and surround sound, and two spacious bedrooms, all with breathtaking views of the surrounding forest and the saltwater pool. One bedroom includes a luxurious king-size bed, while the other offers two comfortable queen beds, providing ample space for relaxation. For guests seeking additional space or privacy, Estudio Sereno is a separate studio available for up to two guests. It features a king-size bed, a fully equipped bathroom, and a unique outdoor shower experience, seamlessly blending with nature.Step outside to enjoy the sprawling three-quarters-of-an-acre property, complete with a skin/eye friendly saltwater pool, an outdoor shower, and a fire pit. Relax on various decks, including a covered one, and immerse yourself in nature.Cabaña Serena seamlessly blends indoors with the outdoors. Main house has Nine-foot-tall glass doors on the main facades enhance this connection, and an open-concept layout encourages social interaction. The architecture prioritizes sustainable and eco-friendly practices, that were envision since the very conceptual design. Some of these featuring includes:* A photovoltaic system for clean energy * Rainwater collection system for landscape irrigation.* Solar extraction fans and cross-ventilated windows with for natural cooling.* Tinted glass to reduce heat absorption.* Energy-efficient appliances and lighting.* Saltwater Pool remains warmer than regular white finished pools, since Solar Thermal Absorption principles were implemented on finishes design.* Mechanical ventilation on all rooms to minimize air conditioning usage.* Usage (as a first choice) locally produced materials to minimize carbon footprint.* A septic system using an eco-friendly aerobic process for water treatment.* Over 150 strategically planted trees and palms for natural shade.* No trees were cut or replanted during the construction phase.Easily accessible, it’s a 45-minute drive from Aguadilla Airport and 2.5 hours from San Juan International Airport. Cabaña Serena, where sustainability meets comfort, is your ideal choice for an unforgettable vacation.*** Please note: Main House provides accomodation for up to 6 guests. Access to Estudio Sereno (Bedroom #3) is optional and requires an additional cost. To book this feature—whether you need extra space for a total stay of up to 8 guests or simply wish to enjoy this private area—you must select an 8 guests stay when making your reservation.Guest accessThere are two lockboxes for access. First lockbox, located on the right side of the pedestrian gate has the key for the padlocks of wooden pedestrian and vehicular gates. Second lockbox is located right in front of the main door, right in front of the house. This one includes the house main door key and the exterior gates padlocks keys. Codes will be sent prior to arrival as they frequently change.If Estudio Sereno is desire for the reservation, another lockbox with its keys is located on the right side of the studio access sliding door.Other things to noteThe main feature that distinguishes Cabaña Serena from other properties in the area is its spacious patios and surrounding nature that provide a great sense of privacy.

title: Wave Coast Town House #1 Pool & Beach for 6 people
description: Spacious townhouse w/ private gated plunge pool, across the street from the beach! Sleeps 6: 2 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms. Enjoy a stocked kitchen & a roof deck w/ ocean & sunset views! All rooms equipped w/ A/C units, gas grill, garage, patio furniture & beach chairs, sun umbrella & cooler.Walk to restaurants, bars, grocery stores, CrossFit gym, sauna & cold plunge spa. Local attractions: surfing, paddleboarding, scuba, sailing, fishing, tennis, pickleball, yoga, massage, yoga & horseback riding.The spaceWave Coast is located in the Stella neighborhood across the street from an excellent swimming beach year-round and is known for its sandy bottom and calm waters. The pathway to the beach is directly across the street from our unit. As you enter the townhouse there is a kitchen, living room, dining area, 1/2 bathroom and garage located on the ground floor. As you walk through the sliding glass door, the private, gated plunge pool is located in the backyard. It features an outdoor table for 4 with an umbrella, a chaise lounge chair, and a gas BBQ grill with gas provided. The Primary bedroom, located on the 2nd floor, features a queen bed and an en-suite bathroom. A/C unit, closet, and dresser as well. There's a charming small balcony off the bedroom that has partial ocean views, accessible only from this bedroom.The second bedroom, also located on the 2nd floor, has two queen beds, two large closets, an A/C unit, and a full bathroom just outside the bedroom door. The third-floor terrace is large and features two separate areas. A dining table with an umbrella and seating for four in one location, and two chaise lounge chairs for relaxing on the other side. The house comes with beach chairs, linens, towels, Wi-Fi, washer and dryer, and more.Wave Coast is conveniently located down the street from the best grocery store in town and a health food store. In the same plaza is a CrossFit gym, sauna, cold plunge spa, and food trucks. The town plaza is 1.3 miles from the rental and offers restaurants, shopping, arts, music, and nightlife.Guest accessGuests have access to the entire townhouse, except for the closet located on the ground floor, which houses the water heater and other mechanical components for the house. There is also a door within the primary bedroom closet that is locked for the owner's items.Other things to notePlease note the ocean can be loud when the waves are big, the frogs can be loud after it rains, and the locals can be loud when having a good time. The island of Puerto Rico frequently has power and water outages. We do not have a back up generator in the event of a power outage.We reserve the right to cancel/limit bookings based on the number of nights during Holiday weeks/weekends (3-7 days). Exceptions to the rule applyWe are located on the western point of the island. We are 30 minutes from the Aguadilla airport (BQN), which has daily flights from JFK, Fort Lauderdale, and Orlando on JetBlue and Newark on United. We are 25 minutes from the Mayaguez airport (MAZ) with 6 flights daily on Cape Air from San Juan. This flight is a great option to cut down on the driving time from San Juan.We are 2.5 hours from the San Juan airport (SJU), which has daily flights on all the major airlines.We are 1.5 hours from Ponce Airport (PSE) Airport with daily flights on Jetblue. Taxi's and Car Services can easily to arranged to and from the airports.

title: Azul Room/ Free Breakfast/Pool/nature/Near Beaches
propertyType: Private room in bed and breakfast
description: Welcome to La Casa Azul B&B. Our Casona is located on the west coast of Puerto Rico; between the villages of Aguada, Aguadilla and Rincón.This is the Blue Room of our House. You will enjoy our pool area, local breakfast included, private forest and our cocoa crop where we give the Cocoa Tour. Just minutes away you will find the best beaches and tourist attractions in the region.We want you to live like a Boricua!The spaceAt Casa Azul, we want you to experience the island in Boricua style! Our private room is spacious, comfortable and has everything you need for a great stay. Our 1950 house is decorated with local rustic touches that give it a Creole style, typical of Caribbean cottages.We want you to feel at home at your grandmother's house in Puerto Rico. The private room has air conditioning, a private bathroom, a refrigerator, a TV, a safe, a luggage rack, a comfortable closet, towels, sheets, and toiletries.In the common areas we have a large terrace, balconies with chairs, hammocks and tables where you can have breakfast, read a book or just relax.In our living room we have a variety of board games, a smart TV with built-in WiFi and local channels, comfortable armchairs and Creole chairs that give it a cultural touch. We have an information table where you will find information and brochures about the best restaurants, beaches, museums, and all the places to visit near us.The dining room has a large table and an island-bar.The kitchen is fully equipped with a stove, sink, microwave, coffee maker, fridge, and all the necessary utensils so you can prepare your own meals before or after exploring.Our breakfast is light and varied, Continental style. We always have coffee, juice, bread, jellies, hams, cereal, milk, and a variety of fruits so you can start your day well. In the garden we have an excellent shared pool area. You'll see our little square with chairs, tables, and umbrellas. We have three gazebos, one of them with a grill. There is a shower area and pool bathroom.Our private forest is the perfect place to be in touch with nature. You can explore the different trails while discovering our nature. You'll see hammocks throughout the forest, a campfire area, and fish ponds. In the forest you can observe birds, connect with nature and do yoga.Inside the forest is our cocoa crop that produces the material to make our chocolate bars.Stay with us and Live the Boricua Life!Guest accessThe house has high-speed WiFi; perfect for watching Netflix on our smart TV, studying or working.We provide towels, toiletries, toilet paper, and garbage bags. If you need more of these resources during your stay, please don't hesitate to ask.The room is equipped with a comfortable queen-size bed, private bathroom, refrigerator, Smart TV, air conditioning, closet, safe, and luggage rack. The kitchen is fully equipped with all the utensils so you can cook your favorite dishes. We always have coffee and tea available to our guests in the house.Breakfast is included in the rate. It is continental, varied and perfect to start your morning right. It consists of cereals, toast, a variety of fruits, hams, cheeses, jellies, coffee, juice, tortillas. In the courtyard there are three comfortable gazebos, a grill and a campfire area in our forest. We have all the equipment for barbecuing except charcoal. This must be purchased by guests. There is a ramp for the disabled in the house that gives access to our second level and the pool area.The pool area has a variety of tables and chairs. It has spaces to put your towel and take a delicious sunbath. It also has its shower and bathroom area. It can be used at any time.In the living room, you will find an information table with lists of museums, parks, taxis, forests, agrotours, beaches, restaurants, and all the places to visit near Casa Azul.We are in an excellent location between the towns of Aguada, Rincon, and Aguadilla. That's why we're the perfect place for surfers and adventurers who like to explore our island.The beaches of all the towns in the northwest are very close to us. Drive between 6 and 15 minutes and you'll find very good paradisiacal beaches.Our Cocoa Tour lasts one hour and the time is coordinated with us to offer it during the stay.Tour hours are Monday through Friday from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM and weekends from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM.Ask us about our variety of private tours exploring Aguada and other western villages.We also have free private parking inside our house.During your stayCheck-in is from 4:00 PM onwards. We like to personally greet our guests to welcome them, give them a tour of the facilities, answer questions, and give them the access keys.We also have the option to send you the instructions for independent access to the house by message or email in case you arrive late at night. We are available to answer any questions about the house or places to explore and visit in our area. So please don't hesitate to reach out or call.Don't forget to ask us about our Cocoa tour and our variety of cultural tours through the villages of Aguada, Rincon, and Aguadilla.I'm a tour guide and historian. Ask about the availability to visit our antique collections that include art, carvings, antique objects, and historical documents from Puerto Rico.Come and live the Casa Azul Experience!Other things to noteExperiences at Casa Azul.We have a variety of activities that you can do in coordination with us that will make your stay unique and fun.Cocoa Tour.In our House we grow cacao where we produce artisanal chocolate.The Cacao tour lasts one hour.The schedule is coordinated directly with you during your stay. Cost: $25 per person.We learn about the history, cultivation and processing of cacao and include a tasting of our craft chocolate.Visit our antique collection. I am a certified tour guide and historian and as part of our offer we have the visit to our collections. The visit lasts 35 minutes and includes a tour of 5 antique, art and carvings that tell the history of the villages of western Puerto Rico.Cost: $5 per person.Tour of Aguada.The tour lasts 2 hours.We explore some of the iconic places in the town of Aguada while walking through the historic center. Cost: 20/person.Casa Azul Rules.Each space has a maximum number of guests. Additional guests who are not notified will be charged an additional fee of $30 per person per night.Smoking is not allowed inside the house or in the rooms. We have an outdoor smoking area. Smoking inside the house will incur a $100 cleaning fee to remove the odor.No pets are allowed on the property except those that are on duty.If you bring pets, a $35 pet fee will apply.We have a water tank and electric generator in the house for your comfort.The pool can be used at any time. Please do not eat or drink in the pool.Do not run or dive into the pool.In the pool area there is an outdoor shower that can be used to wash off sand in case you come from the beach.Check-in will always be at 4:00 pm. If you need to arrive earlier, you must notify us in advance and it will be subject to the availability of your space.Late check out.Check-out is at 12 noon or earlier.Late check-out must be requested in advance and is subject to availability.An additional fee of $15 will be charged for each additional hour after 12pm.The house is for guests only. No strangers or visitors are allowed inside Casa Azul's premises other than Casa Azul's guests or employees.Loud noises, shouting and loud music are forbidden at night. This is for the benefit of all guests and the community.If you are going to use our campfire area or the grill, remember to turn it off after use and throw the ashes in the nearest trash can. Guests must purchase the charcoal.Only Casa Azul guests can use the pool area.Our staff is always ready to help.

description: This 7 bedroom house is situated on a hill with a beautiful view of the ocean from every balcony and the infinity pool. The property is surrounded by tropical gardens with a man-made waterfall. We have a private on-site bar, a large pavilion, and we are located less than a five minute walk from the beach, restaurants and a lively nightlife. Ocean View Paradise in Rincon is the perfect place for your next wedding, family reunion, bachelorette party, retreat or group getaway!The spaceThis 7 bedroom house is made of three floors with separate entrances. Each floor has their own balcony, living room and kitchen with all the basics. The first floor has two bedrooms and one bathroom, the second floor has three bedrooms and three bathrooms and the third floor has two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The second floor has a balcony with an outdoor dining table and seating for the entire house along with amazing ocean views. The common area includes the infinity pool on the first floor, on-site bar, outdoor shower, BBQ gas grill, hammocks event pavilion and seating areas. The outdoor staircase leading from the infinity pool down to the event pavilion is picturesque - great for weddings or Instagram moments. You will be only a three minute walk to one of the best beaches in Rincon, Sandy Beach, and the famous seaside restaurant Tamboo Bar & Grill. You can sit on the beach and have your food or drinks delivered right to your chair! We have beach chairs available for your use.You are also within walking distance to several other restaurants, bars and small grocery store. We provide beach chairs for our guests. Gated, on-site parking is available for up to 8 cars. SUVs and Pickups in the driveway only. description: Please be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!The spaceRomantic, private, and overlooking tropical gardens and the Caribbean Sea, Sea La Vie at The Villas at The Horned Dorset is the epitome of luxury in paradise. Sea La Vie is a one-bedroom, 2 full-bath Moroccan-inspired luxury villa with a private plunge pool. The villa is steps away from a stunning infinity pool and the beach is a one-minute walk away. On this beach, you can enjoy a morning or afternoon dip, appreciate the scenery and let the waves caress your feet. If you are looking to relax, enjoy quiet surroundings, and still have all the fun and action Rincón has to offer a short drive away, then this is the place for you! IMPORTANT NOTE #1: This villa is not located at The Horned Dorset Hotel (which is closed). It is located at the Villas at Horned Dorset, directly beside the hotel. The common areas and pool of the Villas are in pristine condition. Once you get off the main road, you will encounter narrow countryside roads for approx 3-5 minutes until you get to the property.IMPORTANT NOTE #2: The complex offers a full-size generator & water tank in case of an interruption in electrical or water service. It also features Fios high-speed internet and cable TV. IMPORTANT NOTE #3 - PLUNGE POOL MAINTENANCE: The pool man has to access the outdoor patio every Thursday during the morning to clean the plunge pool. No exceptions. Guests do not need to be at the property for this, since they don't need access to the unit. Please reach out to us before booking if you have any questions regarding this service.LIVING AREAYou will love the way the living area seamlessly integrates the beautiful garden and ocean views. There is a 2-person dining table, central AC & TV (inside the antique armoire). The room is elegantly furnished for sophisticated relaxation by the Caribbean Sea. The living and dining room opens to the terrace via two gorgeous wooden doors. The terrace has a private plunge pool overlooking a tropical garden with a 4 person dining table, great for having breakfast, lunch, or a romantic dinner. There are 2 lounge chairs for sunbathing in privacy. The living area features a full bathroom with shower. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSThe master suite is located on the second level of the villa. Upstairs, the ocean views get even better. The villa offers a four-poster mahogany king-size bed, Amalfi ceramics, hand-carved furniture, and a separate sitting area. The grand suite has a luxurious bathroom covered from floor to ceiling with white Carrara marble and features a beautiful oversized freestanding white porcelain bathtub, a shower and His & Hers sinks. PACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability.KITCHENETTEThe kitchenette is located on the 1st level of the villa. It offers a small refrigerator, coffee maker, toaster, microwave oven, a single burner portable stovetop, a blender, and basic pots and pans for simple cooking. GETTING AROUND & PARKINGWe strongly recommend renting a car, as there are a multitude of activities within a 15-30-minute drive that you will not want to miss out on. Also, Uber is not readily available in the area, which is why it's important to have your own means of transportation.The villa includes one (1) unassigned parking spot. LOCATIONThere are many things to do in Rincón, Puerto Rico. This part of the island is best known as "The town of beautiful sunsets." Staying at Rincón you will enjoy a laid-back atmosphere, delicious restaurants, and great surfing beaches. Here are some of our favorite things to do:Explore the large selection of local restaurants. Some of our favorites include The English Rose, La Cambija, Carta Buena, Kaplash, El Tamboo Beside the Point, The Beach House, and La Copa Llena. Check out a new restaurant called La Serina, a great Tiki bar and sushi bar located downtown. Relax at the secluded beach, private plunge pool, an infinity pool at The Villas at The Horned Dorset. This oceanfront property has a private area where guests can wet their feet in the ocean and soak up the sun. The apartment includes beach chairs, beach towels, and coolers.Visit the local beaches like Steps, Maria's Beach, Sandy Beach, Domes Beach, and Corcega.Take a picture of the beautiful "El Faro Lighthouse" at Punta Higuero.Watch an afternoon of surfing at Marías Beach and stop for a drink at the Calypso Bar which is right by the beach.Take a paddle-board tour with the folks at Rincon Paddle BoardsOther things to noteSTARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish spongePlease note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 2 adults/children at all times, including visitors. OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.
